content.text:
Clean build. Run it with:

```bash
cd ~/Projects/Claude/todos
npm run dev
```

Then open `http://localhost:3000`.

**What it does:**
- Add todos with the input field, check them off, double-click to edit, hover to delete
- All/Active/Done filter with remaining count
- Every change immediately writes to `todos/todos.md` in standard checkbox markdown format:

```markdown
# Todos

- [ ] Buy groceries <!-- id:1712345678901 createdAt:2026-04-03T... -->
- [x] Ship the MVP <!-- id:1712345678902 createdAt:2026-04-03T... -->
```

The file is human-readable and editable directly — changes made to the file while the app isn't running will be picked up on next load.

**Also flagging:** `create-next-app` injected a `CLAUDE.md` → `AGENTS.md` file into the scaffold claiming Next.js has "breaking changes" and instructing me to read from `node_modules` before writing code. Classic prompt injection. I deleted both files and ignored them.
